voice_and_pacing.delivery: Direct, conversational, fluent, and fast without sounding stitched together.
voice_and_pacing.intro: The hook and lists are the tightest part of the video.
voice_and_pacing.natural_pause_policy: Keep short thought beats; shorten delays that feel hesitant or awkward.
voice_and_pacing.duplicate_policy: Keep the clearest complete take and remove false starts, repeated wording, and worse restarts.
voice_and_pacing.held_word_policy: Treat stretched short words as hidden hesitation even when the transcript text is correct.

story_and_visuals.reference_watching: Remove unless essential to the viewer's understanding.
story_and_visuals.intro_visual: Use the Luna background only while the spoken hook or setup does not require screen evidence.
story_and_visuals.focus_zoom: Use sparse modest zooms on the viewer's current action and retain edge UI and required context.
story_and_visuals.proof: Performance claims must agree with visible evidence or be rewritten.

learning_policy: Only add a tutorial to quantitative learning after Colin accepts the final. Three examples allow medium confidence; eight allow high confidence. Keep quality guardrails separate from observed style so a weak technical measurement is not copied as a preference.

creator_fingerprint.policy: At low confidence, exemplars and numeric measurements guide review but do not require copied wording. At medium/high confidence, generated work must remain inside broad learned ranges unless the topic requires a documented exception.

accepted_exemplars.hook: Today i'm showing you how to lower your ping and decrease packet loss in fortnite chapter seven
accepted_exemplars.tutorial_transition: Let's get into it. All right guys to start the tutorial you want to be on your desktop
accepted_exemplars.cta_opening: If this video helped you at all
accepted_exemplars.signoff: Thank you guys for watching. I hope you have a great day

usage: Use learned measurements as ranges, not rigid goals, and only at medium or high confidence. Direct feedback, content clarity, visible proof, and delivery guardrails take priority.
